# resonant-evo-x2-ec-notes

Talking to a mini-PC's embedded controller: fan and power-mode control on
EVO-X2/Strix Halo. Adapts the published register map, discovery method, and
deployment patterns from KyaniteLabs/evo-x2-ec for the ResonantOS community.

Canonical source: https://github.com/KyaniteLabs/evo-x2-ec
This writeup: https://github.com/simongonzalezdc/resonant-evo-x2-ec-notes

Community gift by Kyanite Labs for the ResonantOS ecosystem — non-canonical;
the canonical upstream always wins. MIT.

Key facts: 21 EC register offsets documented; APU power-mode register 0x31
discovered May 2026 (validated by bounded-workload + telemetry harness);
systemd re-assertion pattern for persistence.
